payload.title: Directly querying the LiPDGraph
payload.description: This notebook provides a tutorial on querying the LiPDGraph using a direct SPARQL endpoint. It demonstrates how to perform both simple and complex queries on the LiPDGraph, which contains datasets from the LiPDverse in a graph format. The notebook uses the PAGES2k and iso2k compilations as examples to retrieve data and metadata related to temperature analysis.
